summary: P1 Backoffice MVP testing completed. Fixed critical bug in property creation (duplicate slug parameter). All 27 backend API tests passed. Frontend admin panel fully functional with all pages working.

fixed.issue: TypeError: Property() got multiple values for keyword argument 'slug'
fixed.fix: Modified create_property function to handle slug properly without duplicate parameter

ui_bugs.issue: Made with Emergent badge intercepts pointer events on Create Property button
ui_bugs.workaround: Use force=True click or scroll to avoid badge

Properties list page with city filter

Bookings list with status and payment filters
